mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.id AS company_numeric_id, c.company_id AS company_code, c.expiration_date FROM account a INNER JOIN account_company ac ON a.id = ac.account_id INNER JOIN company c ON ac.company_id = c.id WHERE UPPER(a.account_id) = UPPER(#{accountId}) AND (UPPER(c.company_id) = #{companyId} OR UPPER(c.group_id) = #{companyId}) AND a.status = 'active'
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.*, c.id AS company_numeric_id, c.company_id AS company_code, c.expiration_date FROM user u INNER JOIN user_company_map ucm ON u.id = ucm.user_id INNER JOIN company c ON ucm.company_id = c.id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND (UPPER(c.company_id) = #{companyId} OR UPPER(c.group_id) = #{companyId}) AND u.status = 'active'
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET last_login = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE user SET remember_token = #{token}, remember_token_expires = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT secondary_password FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT o.*, c.id AS company_numeric_id, c.company_id AS company_code, c.expiration_date FROM owner o INNER JOIN company c ON c.owner_id = o.id WHERE UPPER(o.owner_code) = UPPER(#{loginId}) AND (UPPER(c.company_id) = #{companyId} OR UPPER(c.group_id) = #{companyId})
mapper.update: UPDATE owner SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{ownerId}
